413:t_3:43.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Of course you are. You have to decide your own life for yourself.」

413:t_3:45.en:
$$レド$$
(There's no need to tell them what the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ really are right now. I can keep it to myself until the time comes...)

413:t_3:46.en:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry to interrupt your touching reunion, but the Commander is angry.」

413:t_3:48.en:
$$レド$$
「Major $$オズマ$$... I apologize for acting alone without authorization.」

413:t_3:49.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Is that all you have to say, Ensign $$レド$$?」

413:t_3:50.en:
$$レド$$
「...I am no longer a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$. No... I am someone who no longer qualifies to be a soldier.」

413:t_3:51.en:
$$オズマ$$
「How do you intend to live from now on?」

413:t_3:52.en:
$$レド$$
「I am no longer a soldier, but I'll keep fighting, to protect what I care about and find how I want to live from now on.」

413:t_3:54.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All right, $$レド$$. In that case, I'll train you all over again.」

413:t_3:55.en:
$$オズマ$$
「I'll train you as a human... and as a man.」

413:t_3:57.en:
$$桂$$
「You were a drifter, but it looks like you've finally found a real home to return to.」

413:t_3:58.en:
$$レド$$
「It's $c... and the $$ガルガンティア船団$$...」

413:t_3:59.en:
$$桂$$
「No, no. Your home is wherever $$エイミー$$ is.」

413:t_3:61.en:
$$モーム$$
「We heard every word: $$エイミー$$ declaring, 'I want to be by your side.'」

413:t_3:62.en:
$$エイミー$$
「H-Huh?! How did you hear that?!」

413:t_3:63.en:
$$桂$$
「How did we hear it? Well, $$チェインバー#pilot$$ relayed it to us.」

413:t_3:65.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「To accurately convey the situation, I picked up the audio and transmitted it to $c.」

413:t_3:66.en:
$$レド$$
「Was there... a problem, $$エイミー$$?」

413:t_3:67.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Uh... well... That's not it, but...」

413:t_3:68.en:
$$オズマ$$
「$$桂$$... I'm counting on you to coach him in that department.」

413:t_3:70.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't really understand, but I'm counting on you. I want to get closer to $$エイミー$$.」

413:t_3:72.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$ is no longer under the $$人類銀河同盟$$'s control. Therefore, he is free in all respects.」

413:t_3:74.en:
$$アルト$$
「How you fly through that sky is up to you.」

413:t_3:75.en:
$$桂$$
「Come on... Let's go see everyone. It wasn't just $$エイミー$$. $$宗介$$, $n, and the others were worried about you all along, too.」

413:t_3:77.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Hold on! Aren't you forgetting about me?!」

413:t_3:80.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Of course I am. With the maintenance skills I honed in $c, I could fully restore the treasure.」

413:t_3:81.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Using it as a weapon made shutting those fleet bastards up a piece of cake.」

413:t_3:82.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「My... You sound quite spirited, even though most of that treasure you're so proud of was destroyed in the battle.」

413:t_3:84.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「But I don't care about that. Somewhere in this wide world, there's bound to be treasure that makes that stuff look like nothing.」

413:t_3:85.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I'm coming too, $$レド$$! I'll travel the world with $c and find even more amazing things!」

413:t_3:86.en:
$$レド$$
「You've found a new way to live, too.」

413:t_3:87.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「I can't stay quiet when I hear about treasure. May I come along, too?」

413:t_3:88.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Even the great pirate $$ラケージ$$ is coming?!」

413:t_3:89.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「My subordinates were also hit quite hard in that battle.」

413:t_3:90.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Don't worry about them. $$リジット$$ says she'll take care of them along with the people of $$クーゲル$$'s fleet.」

413:t_3:91.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Then my days as a pirate are over... In that case, a treasure-hunting journey with $$ピニオン$$ wouldn't be bad at all.」

413:t_3:92.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Y-You want to come with me?!」

413:t_3:94.en:
$$オズマ$$
「In that case, you're welcome here, $$ラケージ$$. I'll look after both you and $$ピニオン$$.」

413:t_3:95.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Thank you. ...First, I must greet the new Empress of the Sea here.」

413:t_3:97.en:
$$ラケージ$$
「Would you show me the way?」

413:t_3:99.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$残されの海$$ may grow quiet, but the storms will keep coming for $c...」

413:t_3:101.en:
$$アルト$$
「Are you feeling all right now, $$ブレラ$$?」

413:t_3:102.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Yes... I had a thorough examination. The function that received external signals inside my body has been completely destroyed.」

413:t_3:103.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「The $$ギャラクシー船団$$ will never control me again.」

413:t_3:105.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「...Then let me say just one thing.」

413:t_3:107.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「Allow me to take back what I said before... that you weren't worthy of $$ランカ$$.」

413:t_3:110.en:
$$桂$$
「It looks like big brother number two has given you his seal of approval.」

413:t_3:112.en:
$$桂$$
「Number one seems to have approved of you long ago, so there are no obstacles left now...」

413:t_3:113.en:
$$桂$$
「All that's left is how you feel.」

413:t_3:115.en:
$$桂$$
「It's just what you told $$レド$$. ...Everything is up to you.」

413:t_3:116.en:
$$桂$$
「Whichever one you choose, or if you choose neither... Whatever happens, don't leave yourself any regrets.」

413:t_3:119.en:
$$桂$$
「I'll teach you all about it someday. It's about men and women.」

413:t_3:121.en:
$$レド$$
「Is there some problem, $$エイミー$$?」
